target.normalLaunch: Steam / supported normal Cyberpunk 2077 launch after REDmod enable/deploy
target.vanillaPlayTarget: REDlauncher Enable mods OFF yields Biology-inactive behavior after issue #44 activation audit

releaseGate.foundationEvidence: The first integrated Cyberpunk 2077 2.31 milestone proved exact compile, package assembly, clean installation, official REDmod recognition of Biology, and real five-stage REDmod deployment.
releaseGate.reason: Public release remains gated on current live body-runtime/UI/presentation follow-ups, launcher-off vanilla-play semantics, self-contained hard uninstall, overlap/precedence evidence, broader gameplay/save/quest/performance acceptance, and final release audit.

components.notes: Accepted Biology runtime payload plus official mods/Biology identity. Tests, reports, staging, local reference mods and source-only tooling stay out of player artifacts.
Directly required by accepted Biology-owned additive/wrapper runtime seams. Bundle only exact pinned files with required notice and per-file ownership.

Biology owns no RED4ext plugin. Retained only as transitive plumbing for the current ArchiveXL/Mod Settings settings-provider chain; issue #44 must also prove this supplemental route is inert when REDmod is disabled or require a different activation strategy.
No direct Biology resource consumer. Retained only because the current Mod Settings adapter depends on it; remove when the provider chain is replaced or no longer required.

Current accessible/persistent adapter for provider-neutral Biology and E3 presentation preferences. It has no entitlement to remain; remove when a Biology-owned provider or deliberate launcher/install boundary satisfies the same product contract.
No current Biology production source/data path requires TweakXL.
Current Biology UI uses native/REDscript routes and has no Codeware dependency.
Current Biology runtime adds no custom input binding requiring Input Loader.
Historical research/provenance may remain in the repository, but executing Dark Future content is forbidden from Biology candidates.

Issue #40 studies the local-only Project E3 reference and durable component inventory to guide Biology-owned presentation. Project E3 scripts, archives and tweaks remain forbidden from player runtime artifacts.
No Cyberpunk executable, stock archive, final.redscripts, save or user settings may enter a Biology artifact. Installed final.redscripts may be read only as an exact-compile base.

artifactRequirements: Game-root-relative paths only for runtime payload.
The official first-party REDmod identity is mods/Biology.

The current integrated artifact contains Biology project-original runtime plus pinned redscript and only the temporary RED4ext/ArchiveXL/Mod Settings chain still justified by the current settings provider.
Every installed file is represented by exact owner/component/route/replace-policy/SHA-256 metadata; shared framework roots are never recursively Biology-owned.
INSTALL.txt describes supported REDmod/Steam activation without relying on a permanent Biology-specific launcher.
BIOLOGY-VERSION.txt, provenance, owner manifest and SHA-256 checksums identify the exact candidate.
Required licenses and third-party notices for every bundled generic dependency are included without development-only files.
Blocked or not-required components cause artifact construction to fail closed rather than silently expanding the dependency stack.
The final player package must support manifest-safe hard uninstall through a self-contained Biology executable once issue #44 is accepted.
Public release remains gated until direct-game and attended acceptance is recorded; successful CI/exact compilation is not live acceptance.
